_comment: GL-Guard configuration for liveplan.glg: phase groups + tunable thresholds. JSON has no comments, so any key beginning with '_' is documentation and is ignored by the loader (Config.from_dict). Thresholds are configuration, not language constants, so a spec is retuned here without touching the DSL.
_phase_groups: Named sets of Langutory phase labels referenced by `phase(q) in G`, `run(G)` and `seen(G)`. Membership matches an exact label OR its single-letter prefix, so fine-grained labels (V_regression_test) belong to the coarse group (Validate) without being enumerated.

params._dwell: theta_N / theta_R / theta_P / theta_V -- a dwell signal fires after this many consecutive step-level occurrences of one phase group (Navigate / Reproduce / Patch / Validate), i.e. the agent is stuck in that activity. 7 is inherited from the legacy DwellTimeRule and validated EXACT (0 discrepancies over 24k+ real steps). Kept as four separate params so each phase can be tuned independently even though they currently share the value.
params._oscillation: r_action -- a periodic action motif (period 1..10, enumerated by `cycle`) must repeat this many times to count as a mechanical loop. 2 is the minimal convincing evidence of a loop (A-A, or A-B-A-B) and matches the legacy OscillationDetector self-loop / two-plus-node thresholds; 1 would fire on any single action.
params._thought: m_thought / r_thought -- thought_oscillation fires on m_thought-long reasoning blocks (1 = a single thought) repeated r_thought times. r_thought=3 is deliberately higher than r_action=2: reasoning legitimately restates a plan more than actions repeat, so 3 consecutive identical thoughts is the point it is clearly circular reasoning or a format-error loop (matches the legacy ThoughtOscillationRule).
params._recurrence: kappa_recur -- oscillation_recurrence (non-blocking advisory) fires when a substantive action has already executed this many times (so on the (kappa_recur+1)-th). 7 was tuned on the default trajectory set: >=5 over-fires on productive edit->test iteration (+218 false positives in shadow), while >=8 isolates clearly-excessive recurrence (measured 8-23x). It only advises, never blocks, because observations are unavailable at the propose hook, so 'stuck' cannot be told from 'productive-but-long'.
params._analysis_only: kappa_fail -- used ONLY by the analysis-only extra_signals.glg (repeated_failed_edit): the same edit identity has failed this many times. 2 = a trend, not a one-off typo. It needs `outcome(x)`, which is empty at the live pre-emptive propose hook (the action has not executed yet), so signals depending on it are for offline analysis, not online firing.

_kinds: The coarse action-kind vocabulary that `kind(q) = K` matches, as produced by adapters.classify_kind. 'submit' is detected over the full command (the legacy ending_flags).
_outcomes: The `outcome(x)` literals. Populated only for committed occurrences in offline analysis; unavailable at the live propose hook.
